description: A source, intermediate operations such as filter and map, and one terminal operation that produces the result.
An operation like filter or map that returns a new stream and does no work until a terminal operation runs.
An operation such as toList, count or findFirst that starts the pipeline and ends the stream.
A collector that builds a map from a key function, with an optional downstream collector for each group.
The property that elements flow through the pipeline one at a time and processing can stop early.
A return type that holds a value or nothing, forcing the caller to decide what absence means.
The Optional method that returns the value or throws an exception you supply when it is empty.
